summary: Missouri renter. Household size is unclear: you first said you live with your dad (72), then said "just me." Nobody is working, and unearned income (pension and/or Social Security) is about $30,000 to $40,000 a year. Savings, rent amount, your own age, and whether you have job-based insurance or Medicare were not confirmed. Recommended: ACA premium tax credit, likely eligible at this income if you have no job-based coverage and are not on Medicare; check the marketplace. Not recommended: SNAP (gross and net income appear above limits, unless high medical costs qualify for the elderly rule), Medicaid (income above the Missouri limit), SSI (income too high), TANF, EITC, CTC, WIC, CHIP, and school meals (no children or no qualifying earned income). A caseworker should confirm household size, dad's status and income, your age and insurance, and savings, and check SNAP eligibility if your dad is in the household.
